_comment: Six-family judge panel. Diversity is the point: seats from six different labs fail in different directions, which is the only cheap signal that a score is real rather than one model's taste. Slugs drift — run `npm run verify:panel` before every gauntlet.
_notes: grok seats carry `enabled` so they can be benched with one word instead of being deleted; set false to drop to a five-seat judge panel and a two-seat visual panel (lower panelQuorum.judge to 3 if you do).
gemini and grok seats sit on their direct APIs, not OpenRouter — if OpenRouter has an outage the panel still reaches quorum.
visualPanel omits the deepseek and kimi seats on purpose: a seat that cannot see the evidence would contribute a confident guess to the median.
gemini leads visualPanel because it is the only adapter with native video understanding; the other seats receive sampled keyframes and are flagged degraded.
panelQuorum.judge=4 of 6 means two dead seats still produce a verdict, three does not.
maxJudgeSpread=25 blocks shipping when the panel is genuinely split rather than averaging the disagreement away.
